A Check In & Check Out Time as per hotel policies [Usually: - Check In 1200 Hrs And Check Out 0900 Hrs in Andaman and Nicobar].
The facilities of Hotel, Services, and Aid Etc. Cannot be matched with developed destinations in Andaman.
In case of Political Unrest, bad weather or sudden breakdown of the vessel we may shift guests to alternative govt ferry and no refund will be entertained during that situation.
Our Executive may change your itinerary depending on the weather condition and ferry availability and will be updated on a daily basis.

All foreign nationals and Indians staying abroad holding passport of different countries (PIO/OCI) needs to register themselves on arrival on Port Blair Airport (Emigration) which should have valid India visa or obtain RAP - Restricted Area Permit, which is valid for 30 days of stay in Andaman.
All the Hotels in Port Blair and Havelock have Extra mattress systems they do not provide Extra beds.

Majority of the Hotels in Havelock do not have room service (all the foods are served on the mail restaurant only), intercom and hot water facilities, although for children and elderly guests hot bucket water is available on request.
Neil Island tours from Havelock are purely subject to weather conditions and availability of ferry, If not the guest will be taken back to Port Blair and an alternative sightseeing will be given.
In Andaman mobile networks are BSNL, AIRTEL & VODAFONE and no other networks are supported.
Hotels in Andaman are categorized on the basis of location, services, costing and not as per Star categorization I.E.; 3*/4*/5*.

We shall not be responsible for any cancellation of the Ferry due to bad weather & We will assist/support you to get the next schedule as per the instructions of local Govt. bodies of Andaman Nicobar.
Important Notes for Transportation:

Vehicle on disposable basis from 08:00 AM to 08:00 PM only in Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nādu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan. Vehicle at point-to-point basis at Andaman from Pick Up place to Drop place as per above itinerary. Driver Bata will be applicable extra for Extra Hrs usage of the vehicle and guests has to pay Driver Bata directly to Driver only. Any additional sightseeing will be charged extra.
Request you to travel with minimum luggage as per the vehicle capacity. We are not responsible for overload luggage issues.
Guests have to cooperate with the driver instructions, if the guest has carried overloaded luggage as per vehicle capacity.
Carriers will be available on vehicles as per state government rules.
Air condition Units / Systems will be switched off on hill Roads, Ghats Where ever applicable.
AC will not operate while the vehicle is stopped. AC will only operate while vehicle is running
If vehicle In Local usage in all destinations above 8 Hrs will have only hourly basis and Extra Kms
The opening & closing Kilometres and Hours will be calculated From Garage to Garage.
We May Have to Re-Schedule the Sightseeing Days Due to The Closing of Any Monument During That Particular Day as To Ensure Smooth Execution of Tours.
Complimentary use of Swimming Pool if available in confirmed Hotel/Resort. (Subject to Government Guidelines)

Need 50% advance booking amount before Cut-off Date and balance amount before arrival for operating above mentioned services.
